findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 3 requests to 2 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 1.5 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 24 kB (2%) came from third-party domains, 24 kB of it from services classified as tracking (2 requests).

1 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: tracking.ringieraxelspringer.tech (Ringier Axel Springer Tech, analytics).
